Something like 12 people have already been killed by lightning this year alone in the US, and I'm not sure if 12 people have been killed in the wild by black bears since 2000.

If you see one a few things to remember. Don't get between two of them, could be a mother and a cub or two males or a male and a female, never a good idea. Never run as they may give chase. Just make yourself loud and big if they show any aggression, and it's a good idea to keep a whistle on you if you are going out into bear country.
